Source: crates.io tokio-tungstenite 0.30.0. Local change: add `WebSocketStream::set_config`, forwarding to tungstenite 0.30's existing `WebSocket::set_config`, so hbbr can bound a WebSocket relay request at its frame header and restore tungstenite's default limits once the leg is paired (upstream rustdesk-server #747). This mirrors the method rustdesk-org added in its tokio-tungstenite fork; the published 0.30.0 release lacks it. No other source changes. This is a downstream compatibility patch, not an upstream release.
The packaged standalone Cargo.lock is omitted; the root workspace lockfile is authoritative. See ../provenance.json for original package checksums and the exact changed-file list.
